title: Choose a Delta-aware scan or table provider
brief: Use the Delta provider for query composition and reliable name-based projection; scan_table provides a direct batch stream. The retained partition-first fixture exposes a LoadBuilder projection-order defect. Raw Parquet reads a different physical relation.

choices.choose_when: SQL, projection/filter planning or joins should compose with DataFusion
choices.tradeoff: The provider holds snapshot state; session-derived scan settings do not imply automatic freshness

choices.choose_when: You need a direct stream of selected logical columns
choices.tradeoff: LoadBuilder is callable by inference but its private canonical module is not an import path

choices.choose_when: You intentionally inspect physical files independently of Delta semantics
choices.tradeoff: Removed rows/files, deletion vectors, partition reconstruction and physical names need separate treatment

claims.statement: LoadBuilder's IntoFuture::Output contains DeltaTable and SendableRecordBatchStream inside DeltaResult; keep streaming errors distinct from builder errors.
The tombstone and deletion-vector fixtures return 0 vs 2 and 8 vs 10 rows respectively when compared with raw Parquet. Column-mapping scans expose logical field names.

The partition-first schema fixture exposed a positional projection defect: scan_table().with_columns(["id"]) returned the label column. The full scan reconstructed id correctly, and projecting id by name through a DataFusion provider returned the requested values. Inspect returned field names and types; do not blindly downcast by position.
A retained provider continues reading its old snapshot after another table handle appends; rebuild from a refreshed table when current results are required.

implementation: Resolve access paths through aliases; canonical paths document identity, not guaranteed public imports.
Preserve the stream schema and apply Arrow kernels that support the actual array representation.
Treat file pruning and row filtering as different promises; inspect TableProvider pushdown contracts.
At this pin prefer provider/DataFrame name-based projection for partitioned schemas; retain the LoadBuilder projection regression control.
errors: A constructed stream can fail during consumption, including after vacuum removed historical files.
unknowns: Predicate pushdown efficiency, allocations and RSS are not measured by the row-correctness fixtures.

evidence.scope: Exact git-capture full contracts for the selected operations
Pinned delta-rs implementation; full file retained with acquisition provenance
Named local assertions only; see profile, fixtures and source digests
